skills.name: Composite - Take off some material from a surface with a tool
skills.description: Use a tool to take off excess material from a surface.

steps.activity: Determine the position on the surface where the excess material will be taken off
Position the tool near the location on the surface
Slide the tool to take off the excess material from the surface

examples: Scrape damaged mortar from a brick joint with a trowel
Remove excess mortar from a brick joint with a flat pointing iron

skills.name: Composite - Brush on a surface to remove dust or debris
skills.description: Use a brush to remove dust, debris, or excess material from a surface.

steps.activity: Determine the position on the surface where the dust, debris and excess material will be brushed off
Position the brush near the location on the surface
Stroke the brush to remove dust, debris and excess material from the surface

examples: Brush loose mortar and debris from a brick wall

skills.name: Composite - Rub an abrasive back and forth on a surface
skills.description: Use an abrasive tool to rub a surface back and forth to remove material

steps.activity: Determine the position on the surface where the abrasive_tool will be rubbed
Position the abrasive_tool near the location on the surface
Rub the abrasive_tool back and forth on the surface to remove material

examples: Rub a pipe with sandpaper to remove rust and corrosion
